svg.aria-label: One account, one identity, two shares: 1. Password: The ExternalSecret renders the SMB password as a file at /run/secrets/pass, so the credential never enters the container environment. 2. Identity: The entrypoint creates the hermes account at uid and gid 10000, and smb.conf forces every session to that identity. 3. Shares: [xml] exports /shared and [files] exports /files, both on RWX CephFS claims, behind one LoadBalancer address on the LAN. 4. Modes: An init container chowns both roots and sets setgid 2770. A postStart hook sets it again once smbd is up, because the entrypoint strips it. 5. Finder: SMB3 only on port 445. vfs_fruit keeps metadata in xattrs, and NFS ACLs are off, so Finder cannot change the owner back.
